note: The reported symptom is a crash: 'Internal compiler error: access violation. Attempted to read from address 0x0000000000000008', i.e. 0xC0000005 from a shipping Release build. Crash-shaped symptoms change shape between builds rather than disappearing, so this is matched on dxc's internal-failure exit statuses (and internal-error text as a backstop) rather than on the reporter's message. The assert-enabled Debug ground truth answers 0xE0000001 'Internal compiler error: LLVM Assert' on the same input; the release binaries answer 0xC0000005 with the reporter's exact wording. is_internal_failure() spans both, so one predicate covers the two signatures and no any_of composition is needed -- see notes.md, where both faces are captured. Deliberately NOT nonzero_exit: without -enable-16bit-types this repro exits E_FAIL 0x80004005 with 'unknown type name int16_t', an ordinary diagnosed error and not a reproduction. Controls: control-uint16.hlsl (the supported spelling, compiles clean) and control-hello.hlsl must both score no-match under this predicate on every probed release.
